items.title: The U.S.-based non-governmental organization HRAI reports that at least 2,000 people have been killed during nationwide protests in Iran. Meanwhile, independent activist sources contend that the nationwide crackdown has resulted in at least 12,000 to 20,000 people killed.
The United Kingdom reports a record 1,564 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 84,767.
